info.title: Scanova API
info.description: Generated from the Zod schemas in @scanova/contracts. Every JSON answer is the envelope { data, error, meta }. Timestamps are UTC in the form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ. /internal/* is reachable from the web app only and is never proxied by the edge.

servers.description: The API origin (behind the edge proxy for /api/v1)

tags.name: internal-admin
tags.description: Requires the service token and an access token with typ=ADMIN, cli=web.
